text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, Nakayama Festa's<n>homeroom teacher
visits my office<n>out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I see... So she's not here either. I'm<n>sorry to have
bothered you while<n>you're working.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Teacher
text_block_list.text: Sigh, now what? If she doesn't getthat assignment in this week, I'llhave to give her a zero for it...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Where to find Nakayama? Uh... I<n>dunno, I never
really talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
She's kinda got a bad vibe, like you<n>shouldn't go
near her. Like, I heard<n>she literally got questioned
by the<n>police the other day...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... One of my friends was out<n>on a jog, and
she saw Nakayama<n>and a policeman arguing by the
riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? How the hell should I know? Idon't care where she is, but I swear,if one more person comes whiningabout Nakayama this, Nakayama that...
choice_data_list: Wait, was someone else looking for her too?
Wait, was someone else looking for her too?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there was some guy asking<n>around for her.
But that's nothing<n>new. I'm guessing she ripped
you off<n>too, huh?
choice_data_list: She ripped someone off? What do you mean?
She ripped someone off? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What, so this isn't about some<n>bet? See, the
thing about Nakayama<n>is...

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I hear she's a damn good cheat at<n>poker. She
whooped a whole pack of<n>idiots, and now they're
after her.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what they put on the table,<n>but they're
lookin' for her like their<n>life depends on it. Yeesh.
Who knows<n>what'll happen if they find her?
choice_data_list:
(No. That doesn't sound right. Nakayama wouldn't
cheat...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, if there's rumors,<n>they've got to lead
somewhere.<n>Eventually. Hopefully... But I've been
chasing leads without much luck.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking around for ages<n>now, but all I've
gotten out of it is<n>more rumors badmouthing
Nakayama.<n>It's just, I find them hard to believe,
knowing how—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, Trainer. You look like a<n>mess. What's
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I explain the chain of events—hearing<n>about the
assignment from her<n>teacher, asking her
classmates<n>where she might be...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her argument with the police, the<n>rumors of her
cheating in poker, and<n>all the other bad things I
heard about<n>her on and off campus.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. I leave the scene for a little<n>while, and
suddenly everyone's<n>makin' up fun stories.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Goes without saying, but none of it's<n>true. They
really believed that I'd<n>cheat? What a bunch of
idiots...<n>Where's the thrill in a rigged game?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I guess whoever's making up<n>rumors must really
be trying to cover<n>their ass. They lost, and now
they're<n>comin' up with excuses to call me the<n>bad
guy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, it makes sense. With all<n>the risky
contests she takes on,<n>there's bound to be a few
sore<n>losers out there. I can't let them<n>scare me off.
I'm her trainer, so...
choice_data_list: If things ever look rough, I'm here to protect you.
If things ever look rough, I'm here to protect you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? You're awful cheery about<n>it. There's
every chance that the<n>people after me might go
after you.
choice_data_list:
Then I'll grit my teeth. I'm in this with you, no
matter what.

Then I'll grit my teeth. I'm in this with you, no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? No matter what? Heh. Guess<n>you can run
your mouth all you want.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just don't go overboard. You're mytrainer, remember?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Far as I'm concerned, races are the<n>real contests.
I'm not gonna take on<n>cheap thrills that could
jeopardize<n>them.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As long as you get that, I don't care<n>what anyone
else thinks. All right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now, let's ease up a bit—both of us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I believe in her, just like I have this<n>whole time.
But... this whole situation<n>has driven home that I still
don't<n>know her as well as I should.
